description: This Java source file defines 'BOMServices', a class implementing various services related to Bills of Materials in a manufacturing context, including calculating maximum depth, updating low level codes, retrieving BOM trees, and handling shipment packaging.

classes.name: BOMServices
classes.description: Contains static service methods for managing Bills of Materials and related operations such as depth calculation, tree retrieval, low level code updates, and shipment packaging.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth of a product in BOM hierarchy for specified BOM types and date, considering all types if none specified.

methods.name: updateLowLevelCode
methods.description: Updates a product's low level code (LLC) based on BOM hierarchy, and optionally updates components and variants accordingly.

methods.name: initLowLevelCode
methods.description: Initializes LLC for all products in the system, setting it to zero and updating related components.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Searches for a duplicated ancestor in the BOM hierarchy to prevent loops or duplicates.

methods.name: getBOMTree
methods.description: Builds and returns a BOM tree (BOMTree object) representing the BOM structure for a product.

methods.name: getManufacturingComponents
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturing components (BOM nodes) for a product, including routing details.

methods.name: getNotAssembledComponents
methods.description: Fetches components of a BOM that are not yet assembled.

methods.name: createShipmentPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages for a given shipment, organizing products into packages based on box types.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Returns components grouped as packages, typically for shipping purposes, with detailed hierarchy.
